title: Choosing an injection payload from the parser context
prerequisites: a confirmed sink where your value reaches an interpreter
the context the value lands in (string, identifier, path, template, serialized object)
excerpt: The payload family follows the context, not the vulnerability name: a value inside a quoted string needs a delimiter and comment strategy, an identifier needs a different escape, a template needs the engine's own expression syntax. Establish the context with a harmless marker first, then take a payload class from a reference and adapt it to the delimiters you observed.
